A safe READ can use real full-return capacity without an AW; a safe WRITE requires actual source supply/independent lease, not only its type. The exact stage83 one-primer, whole-source WRITE-cover, final true physical WLAST rule makes the same prevention and release decisions for C1/C2 and B-tail overlap. It requires no entire F1 predictor. It is a prospective ordinary combination with explicit interfaces/resources, not a native implemented or published full combined mechanism.

Actual first-R contributes one AW credit; RW segmentation and AW coupling are independent. A source envelope feeding several AW children requires paid per-child real first-writable-byte binding or equal segmentation. Stock coupler cannot be assumed to supply the full multi-child rule unchanged. This source gap alone proves no candidate novelty.

Saved source_read_release_q update sits in reset only, with no normal else update. Restricted predicate stability can still preserve old scenes; the variable/comment does not prove a general firstVALID hold across changes. Any new witness relying on that promise needs an actual source-level hold proof or paid lock logic.

Saved Mode5 slot or native512-beat restricted full-job certificate can prevent FIFO exhaustion under its exact domain. The capacity is real and owned; Mode7's inactive array or another flow's occupied storage cannot be claimed as free slots. Physical RLAST is not final shared-slot release while upstream replay remains.
